define.text: The array identifier for one disk, stored on the PersistentVolume.

card.name: test-478-vgr-resync-drpc
card.role: records the requested move and its progression

def.what: The hub record for one protected application. It names the preferred cluster, the failover target and the policy.
def.creator: The DR administrator enrolls the application, or the console does it.
def.reader: Ramen on the hub, the console, and anyone debugging a recovery.
def.analogy: A job ticket that records where the job should run and how far it got.

card.name: test-478-vgr-resync-drpc
card.role: coordinates the group on one site

def.what: The per-site coordinator for one protected application. It finds the claims and asks for replication, restore and cleanup.
def.creator: The Ramen hub operator delivers it to each site.
def.reader: The Ramen controller on that site and the hub.
def.analogy: The site foreman who carries out the job ticket on one site.

card.name: vgr-4251c970ec7af885d6ec79c1d2c40661-test-478-vgr-resync-drpc
card.role: one replication group for every matching claim

def.what: The csi-addons object that asks the storage driver to replicate a set of volumes as one group.
def.creator: The VRG creates it on the site that owns the primary copy.
def.reader: The csi-addons controller, which calls the CSI driver.
def.where: Workload namespace test-478-vgr-resync, on the spoke.
def.analogy: The shipping container that holds several parcels.

card.name: vgrcontent-87f1d6c5-3b5c-4c35-9c25-8b5dee56b03a
card.role: holds the array group handle and every disk handle

def.what: The cluster-scoped record of what the driver actually created on the array: one group handle and the disk handles inside it.
def.creator: The csi-addons controller, after the driver creates the group.
def.reader: The controller and Ramen, including during restore on the other site.
def.analogy: The container manifest: one container number plus the list of parcels inside.

define.text: The array object that copies one volume or one volume group from a source to a destination.
